--- text
abcde|fghij
$$
x^2
$$
--- keys
Down
--- expect
abcdefghij
$$|
x^2
$$
--- note
One Down from the prose line directly above a `$$` block must step ONTO the
opening `$$` line, column-preserving, not skip the whole rendered block. This
is mdEnterDisplayMathFromAbove (md-math-plugin.ts), whose own comment states the
rule: "entering math must not drift the caret horizontally". It lands via
sameColumnOnLine(state, head, startLine).

The caret starts at column 5 ("abcde|fghij"). The opening delimiter line "$$"
is only two characters, so sameColumnOnLine clamps the landing to column 2, the
line end: "motion never drifts horizontally beyond what a shorter target line
forces" (callout-core.ts). So the caret must land after the "$$" on line 2,
which also reveals the block source. Landing at column 0, or on the content line
"x^2", or past the block, would each be wrong.
